svg.title: !ls versus $ls in Claude Code
svg.desc: Two Claude Code terminals. Left: typing !ls runs ls, then Claude starts a turn and you wait for a reply. Right: with quiet-shell, typing $ls, $git status -s and $code . runs each command and returns to the prompt with no model call.
